title: Full Stack Web Developer
description:
**Profile:** Full Stack Developer

**Industry:** Publishing / Self\-Publishing

**Job Location:**  18\. Block E2, BLK Tower Jhandewalan Extension, Metro Station Gate No. 2, New Delhi – 110055

**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**ABOUT BOOKLEAF PUBLISHING**

BookLeaf Publishing is one of India’s leading independent self\-publishing houses, processing 1,200\+ books every month across a catalog of 22,000\+ titles. We operate across India and the US, run our own warehouse and in\-house printing facility in Delhi, and have been featured on Shark Tank India Season 4\. Our mission is to make publishing accessible, transparent, and technology\-driven for authors everywhere.

We are a small, fast\-moving team that punches well above its weight—powered by automation, smart systems, and a bias for shipping. If you thrive in environments where you own outcomes end to end, you’ll fit right in.

**THE ROLE**

We’re looking for a Full\-Stack Developer who can take ownership of our entire technology stack—from our customer\-facing author dashboard and internal operations tools to the AI\-powered automations and integrations that keep our publishing engine running. You won’t just write code; you’ll architect systems, make technical decisions, and directly shape how thousands of authors experience BookLeaf.

This role sits at the intersection of product engineering and AI integration. You’ll work on everything from building and improving web applications to setting up intelligent workflows using AI APIs and automation platforms.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* **Build \& Scale Web Applications:** Design, develop, and maintain our author\-facing dashboard, internal tools, and operations software. Take features from concept to production.
* **AI \& LLM Integration:** Integrate AI capabilities into our products and workflows—connecting platforms like OpenAI, building intelligent automations, managing API keys, and ensuring reliable AI\-powered features in production.
* **Automation \& Workflow Engineering:** Design and manage automation pipelines using tools like n8n, connecting databases, APIs, payment systems, and third\-party services into seamless workflows.
* **API Development \& Integration:** Build and consume RESTful APIs, integrate third\-party services (payment gateways, print APIs, distribution platforms), and ensure robust data flow across systems.
* **Database \& Infrastructure:** Manage databases, optimize queries, handle deployments, and ensure our systems are performant, secure, and scalable.
* **Technical Leadership:** Evaluate architecture decisions, recommend tools and frameworks, mentor junior developers, and establish best practices for code quality and documentation.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with the founding team to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Communicate technical trade\-offs clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* **Strong full\-stack development experience** with proficiency in both frontend (React, Next.js, or similar) and backend (Node.js, Python, or similar) technologies.
* **Hands\-on experience with AI/ML integration:** working with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.), building AI\-powered features, prompt engineering, and understanding how to reliably deploy AI in production applications.
* **Experience with automation platforms** such as n8n, Make, or Zapier—including building complex multi\-step workflows, handling error scenarios, and connecting to external APIs.
* **Solid understanding of databases** (SQL and/or NoSQL), API design (REST, webhooks), authentication systems, and cloud infrastructure.
* **Demonstrated ability to own projects end to end:** from scoping and architecture through deployment and monitoring.
* **Familiarity with Bubble (or willingness to learn it quickly):** Our entire operations currently run on Bubble, and while we’re planning a long\-term migration to a fully code\-based platform, you’ll need to maintain, improve, and build on the existing Bubble dashboard in the interim. Prior Bubble experience is ideal, but we’re equally open to someone who can pick it up fast.
* **Excellent problem\-solving skills** and a track record of building systems that are clean, maintainable, and well\-documented.
* **Strong communication skills:** ability to articulate technical concepts to non\-technical team members and collaborate effectively in a startup environment.

**BONUS POINTS**

* Experience with payment gateway integrations (Razorpay, Stripe).
* Familiarity with e\-commerce platforms (Shopify) and print\-on\-demand workflows.
* Experience with DevOps practices: CI/CD, containerization, VPS management.
* Understanding of publishing, media, or content industry workflows.
* Prior experience in a startup where you wore multiple hats.

**WHY BOOKLEAF?**

* Work directly with the founders in a high\-impact role where your contributions are visible from day one.
* Shape the technology direction of a fast\-growing publishing company at a pivotal stage of its journey.
* Be at the forefront of AI integration in an industry ripe for innovation.
* A culture that values ownership, speed, and building things that matter for real authors.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Send your resume along with links to your portfolio, GitHub, or any live projects to **hr@bookleafpub.com**

Please include a brief note on why you’re excited about this role.

description:
### **Job Information**


* Date Opened 22/09/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry Technology
* Work Experience 1\-3 years
* City Delhi
* Province Delhi
* Country India
* Postal Code 110044
### **Job Description**


**The Short Version** **Who we're looking for:** A strong full\-stack engineer who deeply knows their stack and can also build AI products end\-to\-end. You write clean, performant Node.js and TypeScript, model data well in SQL, build fast search with Elasticsearch, work comfortably on AWS, and ship polished React and Gatsby frontends. You're backend\-heavy and genuinely hands\-on, but comfortable across the full stack. You can take an AI product from idea to production using LLMs, AI agents, APIs, and production\-grade infrastructure, and you take real ownership of what you build. **What the role is about:** You'll design and build the systems behind our web experience \- APIs, data models, search, infrastructure, and AI\-powered products and workflows. You'll work across the full product lifecycle, from architecture and development to deployment and iteration. Strong engineering craft, AI product\-building ability, and product sense are all core to this role. **Why you should apply:** If you love building solid systems and turning AI capabilities into real products, this role gives you deep technical ownership and the opportunity to work on products that directly impact thousands of learners. You'll get to work across traditional software engineering and hands\-on AI product development, with the freedom to build, ship, and iterate rather than simply consume AI tools. **About us:** Kraftshala is India's largest higher\-education institution in terms of marketing placements, with a 94% placement rate, and we are gunning to become the world's largest career launchpad, across domains.  

We're backed by a number of eminent investors including ex\-unicorn startup founders and CXOs of global giants like RedBus, NoBroker, Nestlé, and Performics. **The Detailed Version**  

As a Senior Software Developer (Backend\-Heavy \& AI Product Engineering) at Kraftshala, you'll work closely with product, design, and other engineers to build fast, reliable, scalable web applications and AI\-powered products.  

This role suits someone with strong engineering fundamentals and depth in their tools, combined with hands\-on AI product\-building ability, product thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to take ownership in a fast\-moving startup. **Responsibilities \& Metrics*** **Build and ship backend services and APIs:** Design and build scalable backend systems in Node.js and TypeScript. Metrics to measure: API performance, reliability, delivery timelines, and post\-release defects.
* **Build AI\-powered products end\-to\-end:** Build production\-ready AI products using LLMs, AI agents, APIs, and external systems \- from architecture and implementation through production deployment and iteration. Metrics to measure: time to production, reliability, adoption, task completion, latency, and cost efficiency.
* **Build and optimise data and search systems:** Design performant SQL data models and Elasticsearch\-powered search and discovery experiences. Metrics to measure: query/search performance, data integrity, relevance, and indexing reliability.
* **Own cloud infrastructure and deployment:** Deploy, scale, monitor, and optimise backend and AI systems on AWS. Metrics to measure: uptime, incident frequency/recovery, deployment reliability, and infrastructure/AI costs.
* **Build user\-facing product experiences:** Develop polished React/Gatsby experiences on top of the systems you own. Metrics to measure: feature adoption, page performance, and post\-release defects.
* **Own technical architecture and projects end\-to\-end:** Make sound frontend, backend, and AI architecture decisions and independently take projects from problem definition through production. Metrics to measure: on\-time delivery, system reliability and scalability, technical debt, and production performance.

 **Top Grading*** **Problem Solving:** An A\-player breaks complex engineering and AI problems into elegant solutions independently, whereas a B\-player needs frequent direction.
* **Code Quality \& Craft:** An A\-player consistently writes clean, well\-tested, maintainable code and builds reliable production systems, whereas a B\-player prioritises getting something working over long\-term quality.
* **Ownership \& Accountability:** An A\-player takes full ownership of product outcomes from idea to production \- including what happens after deployment \- whereas a B\-player limits responsibility to assigned tickets.
* **AI Product Engineering:** An A\-player can independently turn an AI product idea into a reliable production system using LLMs, agents, APIs, and application engineering, whereas a B\-player has primarily experimented with AI tools without being able to build complete products.
* **Product Thinking:** An A\-player deeply understands user needs and identifies where technology can genuinely improve the product, whereas a B\-player implements requirements without enough consideration of the underlying user problem.

 **Must Haves**  

* 2\-3 years of experience building web applications with Node.js and TypeScript on the backend, and React on the frontend. *(We are not too fussed about the number of years \- experience is simply a proxy for capability, which is what we really care about.)*
* Hands\-on experience building AI products end\-to\-end using LLMs, AI agents, and APIs, from problem definition and architecture through implementation, production deployment, and iteration.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals, including ES6\+ features, asynchronous programming, and modular architecture.
* Solid experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs, and building backend services that are efficient, secure, well\-documented, and clean.
* Strong command of SQL and relational database concepts \- schema design, indexing, and writing performant queries.
* Hands\-on experience with Elasticsearch for indexing, querying, and relevance tuning.
* Working knowledge of AWS for deploying, scaling, and monitoring services.
* Experience building frontends in React, with familiarity with Gatsby, and an eye for product polish and detail.

 **Good to Haves**  

* Familiarity with GraphQL alongside REST.
* Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code and CI/CD pipelines on AWS.
* Exposure to caching, queuing, or event\-driven architectures.
* Familiarity with Netlify, WordPress, or other JAMstack tooling.
* Contributions to the open\-source ecosystem.
* Comfort with observability tooling such as logging, metrics, and tracing.

 **Selection Process**  

As a small team, it's imperative that we get to know each other before taking the leap. We want to ensure you succeed in your role within our team. Each conversation with us will last about 40\-60 minutes. The process will occur over a mix of online calls and in\-person conversations.* **Setting Expectations:** A call with the HR team to understand your profile and share the details of the selection process.
* **Technical Assessment:** An assessment designed to evaluate your fit for the role, with a focus on backend problem\-solving and hands\-on AI product building.
* **Technical Interview:** A conversation with our Tech Lead covering the core competencies needed for the role, including backend engineering, system design, product thinking, and AI product development.
* **Culture Fit Conversation:** A conversation with our CEO to ensure there is a fit with the Kraftshala Kode.
* **Extending an Offer:** If all goes well, we'll extend an offer with the relevant details.

 **Location**  

Delhi ***Know more about Kraftshala’s philosophy, culture, and investors*** ***here******.***
